sections.heading: SAIC Motor｜AI Agent Developer · Intern｜2026.02 - 2026.07
sections.text:
Delivered four agents for engineering, product planning and project management teams in Shanghai, serving around 500 internal users in total.

Built agents for connector selection, competitive analysis, PRD generation and review, and black-box testing, addressing cost-reduction briefs from three departments.

Connector selection: an 8.5k-line Python system using Flask, LangChain and MongoDB. An LLM decomposes requests into exact, fuzzy and range queries across five product collections with automatic field mapping. Engineer-confirmed results become reusable knowledge-base templates. Shipped eight releases, including a dataset migration and a simpler fallback path.

Competitive analysis: an LLM-driven crawler collects public vehicle-owner reviews into MongoDB. Six chapter-level agents form a pipeline that produces a structured, evidence-backed report.

AUT: a 3.1k-line Python black-box testing tool. Playwright locates the chat interface, captures live API calls and produces replayable request templates, with manual handoff for CAPTCHA, SSO and MFA. Staged load tests stop on success-rate, error-rate and p95 thresholds; probes check prompt injection, cross-session leakage and output stability.

Measured the connector agent at 100% success and 14.2-second p95 with 20 concurrent users. At 500 concurrent users, success fell to 94.9%, with 51 of 1,000 responses empty or malformed. These measurements identify a degradation point, not a universal performance guarantee.

sections.heading: Zhengzhou JIEAN Hi-Tech｜Computer Vision Algorithm Engineer · Intern｜2025.09 - 2026.01
sections.text:
Built vision algorithms for a special-operations competency examination system in Zhengzhou, owning deployment across three production lines.

Worked on an examination system with the municipal emergency-management bureau. Four to five synchronized cameras assess procedural compliance and completeness. The system ran live exams every working day for over a month; I owned three production lines and defined annotation standards with the data team.

Replaced YOLO detection plus hand-written rules with graph-based scoring. YOLOv8 extracts component centres, sizes, angles and classes; assembly constraints connect them into a graph, and a graph convolutional network predicts installation and step-completion states.

Models reached around 90% accuracy in internal acceptance testing. Human co-invigilation and tablet scoring provided a fallback so an algorithm failure would not interrupt an exam.

sections.heading: Shanghai GWE Electric Group｜Software Development Assistant · Automation｜2024.01 - 2024.02
sections.text:
Worked on intelligent systems and automation in January and February 2024.

Helped develop an interactive periodic-table display, connecting the visual interface, control logic and physical actuators for an educational installation.

Integrated physical exhibits with digital controls to present chemistry and safety concepts, supporting changes in display state and visitor interaction.

Taught introductory robotic-arm programming to visiting students and guided the assembly, debugging and verification of racing kits.

Independently modelled, printed and iterated FDM prototypes for the display and its structural parts. Used Yamaha robot teach programming and I/O control in basic equipment commissioning.

sections.heading: Shanghai Asia-Pacific MITAC Computer｜Java Web Software Engineer · Intern｜2023.07 - 2023.08
sections.text:
Developed and maintained enterprise Java Web features and tuned database access under peak traffic.

Built business features, accompanying front-end pages and a WeChat Mini Program within an existing enterprise system.

Re-sized the connection pool, replaced row-by-row reads and writes with batches, and simplified queries. Peak-hour connection-wait alarms stopped after the changes.

The lasting lesson was methodological: locate where the waiting actually happens before changing a parameter.
